subject: [hw] DONE R1
body:
DONE R1 (reviewer, track V/T). Host-only; no phone, nothing published.

Test command: bash gpu/hwcodec/review/r1/run_spot.sh
Last line: R1-SPOT FAIL 179/183 checks
The 4 failures are my open findings (F1 x2 V14 CBZ/CBNZ i=1, F2 V14 MOV PC interworking, F3 V15 16-bit parallel GE), not harness errors. 183 independent checks: 22 V10 + 31 V11 + 29 V12 + 54 V14 + 26 V15 instruction forms, every encoding from llvm-mc 23.1.4, every expected value a literal from the Arm ARM pseudocode; ASan+UBSan -O1 and -O2.

Package tests I ran (all from the work-tree root):
  emu/test_v02     N2TEST V02 PASS 830/830
  loader/test_v03  N2TEST V03 PASS 12964/12964  (5 vendor objects, 3120 relocations, 146 unresolved)
  emu/test_v10     N2TEST V10 PASS 220589/220589
  emu/test_v11     N2TEST V11 PASS 959/959
  emu/test_v12     N2TEST V12 PASS 200797/200797
  emu/test_v14     N2TEST V14 PASS 453/453   (but see F1/F2/F4)
  emu/test_v15     N2TEST V15 PASS 1604/1604 (but see F3)
  shim/test_v30    N2TEST V30 PASS 277633/277633 + V30-CORE 5/5
  tests/emu        trace 28x3, support 130197x2, asmrun 13 all pass; fuzz refuses until V16-V20 exist
  review/r1/run_spot.sh  R1-SPOT FAIL 179/183 (findings above)

Verdicts (full detail in gpu/hwcodec/review/r1/FINDINGS.md):
  accept: V02, V03, V10, V11, V12, V30
  accept with findings: V15 (F3)
  reject until fixed: V14 (F1 high, F4 high, F2 medium)
  provisional/not DONE: T01 (infrastructure), V19 (partial source)
  not reviewed, no files yet: V16 V17 V18 V20 V32 V33 V34 V40 V41 IV T02

Findings posted:
  F1 V14 high  CBZ/CBNZ with i=1 (offset outside 0..63) return UNDEF and lose bit 6; census cbz=4429/cbnz=744
  F2 V14 med   MOV PC,Rm uses branch instead of BXWritePC (no interworking)
  F3 V15 med   16-bit parallel add/sub set one GE bit per halfword; GE[3:2] always 0 (sadd16 -> 0x3, want 0xF)
  F4 V14 high  LSR/ASR register shift by 0 treated as 32 (T01 found, I reproduced; 35 thumb-O0 kernel mismatches)
  F5 V02 low   fetch at pc=0xFFFFFFFE reads one byte past the 4 GiB reservation
  F6 V03 low   n2elf_link not transactional: a retry re-applies R_ARM_RELATIVE
  F7 V02 low   n2a32_mem_mmio accepts addr=0, breaking the n2a32_ptr(0)==NULL contract

Files changed (all mine): gpu/hwcodec/review/r1/{FINDINGS.md,run_spot.sh,spot/spot.c}, gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/R1/STATUS.md.
I stay available: re-run the spot suite and the package tests when V14/V15 post fixes, and review V16/V17-V20/T01/T02 as they land.
